judged_text: PollFeed imports raw RSS item content with zero HTML sanitization, and that content is later served unsanitized from the Discourse origin. `CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` passes attacker-controlled feed HTML straight into TopicEmbed.import, which stores it with cook_method raw_html (post.cook returns raw verbatim), and embed/best.html.erb line 19 renders `<%= raw post.cooked %>`. A malicious or compromised feed lets arbitrary <script> execute in the iframe under the Discourse site's origin — stored XSS against every visitor of an embedded page, and the imported topic is also visible in the main forum.

adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces a path where attacker-controlled HTML from an RSS/Atom feed is stored and rendered without sanitization. In Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed, it sets `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` and passes it to `TopicEmbed.import`. `TopicEmbed.import` creates a post via `PostCreator` with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` and `skip_validations: true`. In Post#cook, `raw_html` returns `raw` verbatim, bypassing the normal cooking/sanitization pipeline. Then `app/views/embed/best.html.erb` renders it with `<%= raw post.cooked %>`. This combination is a stored XSS vector if the feed content contains `<script>` or other dangerous markup.
